Title: LSJ / Mr Coupe - some rules questions

Messages.Author: Anam
Messages.Body:
Further to our demo session today they following questions need to be
clarified (please) ?

1) Vote Pushing - can the caller of the vote play another vote card
from their hand to 'push' the vote ? I said no but would check with
you guys as I thought the caller can't push it but other players CAN
play a single vote card to gain one vote.

2) Please clarify what happens with 'steal blood' , especially when it
comes to first strike.

example 1 - player A plays first strike (muddles vamp hunter), player
b plays steal blood. I ruled that player a's strike happen first so
players b strike didn't happen at all. Was that right?

3) Mummies - when blocked, does the card go to the ash heap - ie
relating to it being shuffled back into your library if sent to the
ash heap - I said yes if its blocked, no if its discarded from hand ?
was that right?

4) Majesty - does this card now cost 1 blood at inferior aswell ? I
couldn't find details in the errata sheets?

5) derange (malk anti card) - player a plays derange on player b,
player b then plays it on player c. (A) is that legal (i said yes) (B)
is the effect moved to player b (i said yes) (C) are the restrictions
the same ie younger vamp ? (i said yes) Was all that right?

I just want to make sure I did the right thing.

any way, many thanks in advance

Anam

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
"Anam" <vt...@blueyonder.co.uk> wrote in message news:e9725951.02111...@posting.google.com...

> Further to our demo session today they following questions need to be
> clarified (please) ?

Well its not addressed to me but I'll give it a shot..... :-)

> 1) Vote Pushing - can the caller of the vote play another vote card
> from their hand to 'push' the vote ? I said no but would check with
> you guys as I thought the caller can't push it but other players CAN
> play a single vote card to gain one vote.

If a vote card was used to call a vote, that card counts as the one
vote that the methuselah can "push". Cannot discard another vote card
for a second vote. If the vote is called from a card in play, like to burn
the anarch revolt, as the calling methuselah has not played a vote card,
they may discard 1 card to "push" the vote.

> 2) Please clarify what happens with 'steal blood' , especially when it
> comes to first strike.
>
> example 1 - player A plays first strike (muddles vamp hunter), player
> b plays steal blood. I ruled that player a's strike happen first so
> players b strike didn't happen at all. Was that right?

Depends. First strike is resolved prior to any other strikes other than combat ends
(and is avoided by dodges). So the muddled vampire strikes for 4 damage
(assuming no lucky blow, etc). If the vampire (B) is not going to be sent
to torpor by this strike, their strike will then resolve, the theft will then remove
the muddled vampire's one life. If B is going to torpor from the first strike
then they do not get a strike.

> 3) Mummies - when blocked, does the card go to the ash heap - ie
> relating to it being shuffled back into your library if sent to the
> ash heap - I said yes if its blocked, no if its discarded from hand ?
> was that right?

I assume we are talking about "if {mummy} is burned, shuffle him into
his owner's library."
I'm not sure what exactly you are asking. The mummy is in play, takes an
action, and is blocked?

> 4) Majesty - does this card now cost 1 blood at inferior as well ? I

> couldn't find details in the errata sheets?

Yes. Cost for the card is now 1 (inferior and superior). However the
superior no longer requires a vampire to burn 1 blood to untap.

> player b then plays it on player c. (A) is that legal (i said yes) (B)
> is the effect moved to player b (i said yes) (C) are the restrictions
> the same ie younger vamp ? (i said yes) Was all that right?

I'll let someone with more experience with derange answer this one.

-JTP

Messages.Author: Flux
Messages.Body:
Anam wrote:

> Further to our demo session today they following questions need to be
> clarified (please) ?

IANLSJ, but here are some answers anyway:

> 1) Vote Pushing - can the caller of the vote play another vote card
> from their hand to 'push' the vote ? I said no but would check with
> you guys as I thought the caller can't push it but other players CAN
> play a single vote card to gain one vote.

Right.

> 2) Please clarify what happens with 'steal blood' , especially when it
> comes to first strike.
>
> example 1 - player A plays first strike (muddles vamp hunter), player
> b plays steal blood. I ruled that player a's strike happen first so
> players b strike didn't happen at all. Was that right?

OK, assuming no First Strike:
Steal blood effects will resolve at the same time as normal strikes.
Damage, however, will only be healed (ie, burn blood) at the end of the
strike's resolution, so stealing blood will happen before damage is healed.

Now, with First Strike:
First Strike is a 'new' strike resolution, that happens before the
normal strike resolution. That means that all the effects of the First
Strike (including burning blood to heal damage) will happen before the
normal strike can be applied. If that means that any minion goes to
torpor, combat ends immediatelly, and any further strikes are 'lost'.

So, your example was correct, assuming player b's minion goes to torpor
from the Hunter's strike. If not, his strike would still resolve.

> 3) Mummies - when blocked, does the card go to the ash heap - ie
> relating to it being shuffled back into your library if sent to the
> ash heap - I said yes if its blocked, no if its discarded from hand ?
> was that right?

I'll assume you mean 'when the recruting action is blocked'. He goes to
the ash heap, since his his own text is not in effect. It only kicks in
when the mummy enters play, at the end of the recruitment action.

> 4) Majesty - does this card now cost 1 blood at inferior aswell ? I
> couldn't find details in the errata sheets?

Yes, Majesty now (since CE) costs 1 blood.

> 5) derange (malk anti card) - player a plays derange on player b,
> player b then plays it on player c. (A) is that legal (i said yes) (B)
> is the effect moved to player b (i said yes) (C) are the restrictions
> the same ie younger vamp ? (i said yes) Was all that right?

Hm, don't have the cardtext here with me and WW's site seems to be down
so I can't confirm, but I think that is right.

> any way, many thanks in advance

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"John P." wrote:
> "Anam" <vt...@blueyonder.co.uk> wrote

> > 1) Vote Pushing - can the caller of the vote play another vote card
> > from their hand to 'push' the vote ? I said no but would check with
> > you guys as I thought the caller can't push it but other players CAN
> > play a single vote card to gain one vote.
>
> If a vote card was used to call a vote, that card counts as the one
> vote that the methuselah can "push". Cannot discard another vote card
> for a second vote. If the vote is called from a card in play, like to burn
> the anarch revolt, as the calling methuselah has not played a vote card,
> they may discard 1 card to "push" the vote.

Correct.
Each Methuselah (including the one who called the referendum) can use no
more than one Political Action card to gain a vote.

> > 2) Please clarify what happens with 'steal blood' , especially when it
> > comes to first strike.
> >
> > example 1 - player A plays first strike (muddles vamp hunter), player
> > b plays steal blood. I ruled that player a's strike happen first so
> > players b strike didn't happen at all. Was that right?
>
> Depends. First strike is resolved prior to any other strikes other than combat ends
> (and is avoided by dodges). So the muddled vampire strikes for 4 damage
> (assuming no lucky blow, etc). If the vampire (B) is not going to be sent
> to torpor by this strike, their strike will then resolve, the theft will then remove
> the muddled vampire's one life. If B is going to torpor from the first strike
> then they do not get a strike.

Correct.

> > 3) Mummies - when blocked, does the card go to the ash heap - ie
> > relating to it being shuffled back into your library if sent to the
> > ash heap - I said yes if its blocked, no if its discarded from hand ?
> > was that right?
>
> I assume we are talking about "if {mummy} is burned, shuffle him into
> his owner's library."
> I'm not sure what exactly you are asking. The mummy is in play, takes an
> action, and is blocked?

If the action to recruit the mummy is blocked, the card is placed in the
ash heap. Its card text doesn't activate on the failed action.

> > 4) Majesty - does this card now cost 1 blood at inferior as well ? I
> > couldn't find details in the errata sheets?
>
> Yes. Cost for the card is now 1 (inferior and superior). However the
> superior no longer requires a vampire to burn 1 blood to untap.

Correct. It is printed with 1 blood cost in the CE, so the change is
not errata. The change is listed in the card text migration list, though.

> > 5) derange (malk anti card) - player a plays derange on player b,
> > player b then plays it on player c. (A) is that legal (i said yes) (B)
> > is the effect moved to player b (i said yes) (C) are the restrictions
> > the same ie younger vamp ? (i said yes) Was all that right?
>
> I'll let someone with more experience with derange answer this one.

If by "player" you mean "vampire":

A. Yes (card text).

B. I don't understand the question. The card's effect applies to the vampire
it is on.

C. No. The restrictions are as given in card text.
